anchor.statement: Lemma 10.3. The force in (10.5) extends to f ∈ C ∞ c ( R3 × (0, ∞ ); R3 ), with support contained in K × [0, 2].

correspondence.note: The force is smooth, compactly supported in t > 0 and equals the residual for 0 < t < 1, but its support is contained in [1/16, 21/16] × 2K (the doubled cylinder) rather than K × [0, 2]. The extension through t = 1 is done for the periodized residual (exists_candidate_force) and then cut off in space and time; of_localized_fields takes a periodic candidate as hypothesis.

∀ {A B : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField} {P : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField}

  NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.CandidateProperties (NavierStokes.R3CompactCandidate.periodicVelocity A B)
      (NavierStokes.R3CompactCandidate.periodicPressure P) f →
    ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) f →

        (NavierStokes.R3CompactCandidate.pressure P)
        (NavierStokesR3.PositiveTimeForce.force (NavierStokes.R3CompactCandidate.compactForce f))
        NavierStokes.SpatialLocalization.supportCylinder

∀ {f : NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.VelocityField} {K : Set NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.Space},

      tsupport (NavierStokesR3.PositiveTimeForce.force f) ⊆ Set.Icc (1 / 16) (21 / 16) ×ˢ K

type.text:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  TendstoLocallyUniformly
    (fun (t : ℝ) (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) =>
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
        (fun (z : ℝ × NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) =>
          NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual u p z.1 z.2)
        (t, x))
    (fun (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) => L x n) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1))

∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 1,
  ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence u t x = 0

leaf.text: iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F (1, x) = L x n

|((iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (t, x)) fun (i : Fin m) =>
          NavierStokes.CompactForceDecay.spacetimeCoordinate (directions i)).ofLp
      j| ≤
  C * (1 + t) ^ (-K)

conclusion.text:
NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.CandidateProperties (NavierStokes.TimeLocalization.activatedVelocity u)
    (NavierStokes.TimeLocalization.activatedPressure p) F ∧
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F ∧
    NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.UnitSpatialPeriodsOn Set.univ F ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ), 2 ≤ t → ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), F (t, x) = 0) ∧
        (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F (1, x) = L x n) ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
            0 ≤ K →
              ∃ (C : ℝ),
                0 < C ∧
                  ∀ (t : ℝ),
                    0 ≤ t →
                      ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) (directions : Fin m → Fin 4) (j : Fin 3),
                        |((iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (t, x)) fun (i : Fin m) =>
                                  NavierStokes.CompactForceDecay.spacetimeCoordinate (directions i)).ofLp
                              j| ≤
                          C * (1 + t) ^ (-K)

exact.text:
∀ (u : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField) (p : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.PressureField),
  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.preSingularDomain →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) p NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.preSingularDomain →
      ∀
        (L :
          NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space →
            FormalMultilinearSeries ℝ NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpaceTime NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
        (∀ (n : ℕ),
            TendstoLocallyUniformly
              (fun (t : ℝ) (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) =>
                iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
                  (fun (z : ℝ × NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) =>
                    NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.navierStokesResidual u p z.1 z.2)
                  (t, x))
              (fun (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) => L x n) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1))) →
          NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.UnitSpatialPeriodsOn (Set.Ico 0 1) u →
            NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.UnitSpatialPeriodsOn (Set.Ico 0 1) p →
              (∀ t ∈ Set.Ico 0 1,
                  ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space),
                    NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.spatialDivergence u t x = 0) →
                NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.SpeedUnboundedAtOne u →
                  ∃ (F : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.VelocityField),
                    NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.CandidateProperties
                        (NavierStokes.TimeLocalization.activatedVelocity u)
                        (NavierStokes.TimeLocalization.activatedPressure p) F ∧
                      ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F ∧
                        NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.UnitSpatialPeriodsOn Set.univ F ∧
                          (∀ (t : ℝ), 2 ≤ t → ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), F (t, x) = 0) ∧
                            (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space), iteratedFDeriv ℝ n F (1, x) = L x n) ∧
                              ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
                                0 ≤ K →
                                  ∃ (C : ℝ),
                                    0 < C ∧
                                      ∀ (t : ℝ),
                                        0 ≤ t →
                                          ∀ (x : NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space) (directions : Fin m → Fin 4)
                                            (j : Fin 3),
                                            |((iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F (t, x)) fun (i : Fin m) =>
                                                      NavierStokes.CompactForceDecay.spacetimeCoordinate
                                                        (directions i)).ofLp
                                                  j| ≤
                                              C * (1 + t) ^ (-K)
